description.en:
Plays the game-over screen and returns to the title screen.
It fades both screens out (CMND_BRIGHT_FADE_ALL(-1.0, 30)), loads the "gameover" image and the music _snd, then shows the image, fades the top screen in and plays the music. After 120 frames it shows message "ev9999" (CreateSpeech) and fades both screens out. When the music has finished it closes it, deletes the image and calls CMND_GOTO_TITLE().
The story events call it on the branch where the player has lost.
Music played on the game-over screen (opened with CMND_SND_OPEN_BGM).

examples.case: A game-over branch of a story event (real usage, from ev42034000.nut)
